name: Aquaguard A Star UV
summary: Aquaguard Sure A Star is a compact UV water purifier designed for municipal water (TDS up to 200 ppm). Equipped with UV E-Boiling Technology , it delivers safe drinking water with 99.9999% bacteria and 99.99% virus reduction.
intro: The Aquaguard Sure A Star is a compact UV water purifier designed for municipal water with TDS up to 200 ppm. Featuring UV E-Boiling Technology, it delivers water as safe as water boiled for over 20 minutes while reducing 99.9999% of bacteria and 99.99% of viruses. Its sleek wall-mount or countertop design, smart LED indicators, and change filter alerts ensure convenient, reliable, and hassle-free access to safe drinking water.
features: UV E-Boiling Technology for advanced purification
Suitable for municipal/soft water (TDS up to 200 ppm)
Smart LED indicators for filter life, service, tank full & errors
Compact design with drip tray for easy filling
